text: Hello there! Would you like to enter the\nAcademy Ace Tournament?

label: common_2090_staff_03
text: OK, you’re all registered as a contestant. Please\nhead down to the battle court.

label: sub_012_announce_00
text: Welcome, one and all, to another thrilling\nAcademy Ace Tournament!

label: sub_012_announce_01
text: Let’s get right to it and kick off the first round!\nWho will the fates pair up today?!

label: sub_012_announce_02
text: Next up is the second round! I’m sure you’re\nready to hear the matchup, so let’s get to it!

label: sub_012_announce_03
text: Finally, only four Trainers remain! Time for our\ncontestants to face their third matches, everyone!

label: sub_012_announce_04
text:
There’s one last match in this tournament, ladies
and gentlemen.\c
These two Trainers will be facing off to finally
determine who’s the strongest in the academy!

label: sub_012_announce_intro_00
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Champion [VAR 0x0100(0000)] will\nbe facing...

label: sub_012_announce_intro_01
text: the cook of legends, Arven from class 2-G!

label: sub_012_announce_intro_02
text: the ex-star-ordinary hacker—it’s Penny from\nclass 1-D!

label: sub_012_announce_intro_03
text: our very own battle studies teacher, the hot-\nblooded Ms. Dendra!

label: sub_012_announce_intro_04
text: our very own mathematics teacher—the savvy\nstatistician, Ms. Tyme!

label: sub_012_announce_intro_05
text: our very own history teacher—the intrepid\nexplorer of antiquity, Ms. Raifort!

label: sub_012_announce_intro_06
text: our very own medical expert—the angel of the\nnurse’s office, Nurse Miriam!

label: sub_012_announce_intro_07
text: our very own home economics teacher—the gruff\nyet homey Mr. Saguaro!

label: sub_012_announce_intro_08
text: our very own biology teacher! He’s a free and\nbreezy fella—it’s Mr. Jacq!

text: our very own languages teacher! He talks the talk\nlike no other—it’s Mr. Salvatore!

label: sub_012_announce_intro_10
text: The strongest-ever student council president!\nIt’s Champion Nemona!

label: sub_012_announce_intro_11
text: our very own academy director—it’s the man of\nimpeccable manners, Mr. Clavell!

label: sub_012_announce_intro_12
text: our very own art teacher—the roaring dragon,\nMr. Hassel!

label: sub_012_announce_intro_13
text: the chairwoman of the school board AND the\nTop Champion herself—it’s Ms. Geeta!

label: sub_012_chara_01_01
text: Argh! Why you, of all people? I’ve got one shot\nat this... I can’t blow it![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: sub_012_chara_01_02
text: Tch! Guess getting pitted up against my little\nbuddy was just my bad luck![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: sub_012_chara_02_01
text: M-my Veevees and I won’t back down—even up\nagainst you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: sub_012_chara_02_02
text: Crazy strong, as always... But y’know what?\nI’m proud of you.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: sub_012_chara_03_01
text: Prepare to taste defeat, new kid! You’re no\npushover, but neither am I![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: sub_012_chara_03_02
text: Hate to say it, but you beat me! Best of luck in\nyour next battle![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: sub_012_chara_04_01
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Oh, my. Hello, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]. Let’s
make
this
a
nice,
friendly
battle,
shall we?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: sub_012_chara_04_02
text: Oh, if only I could have battled you in my prime.\nKeep up the excellent work![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: sub_012_chara_05_01
text: Hello, my little student. I look forward to\ndeciphering the secret to your skill.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: sub_012_chara_05_02
text: History is written by the victors. Cast aside the\nvanquished and ascend your rightful throne.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: sub_012_chara_06_01
text: The “angel of the nurse’s office”? Seriously? Ugh.\nWell, whatever. Let’s have a heavenly battle![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: sub_012_chara_06_02
text: I’ll heal you up if you get injured, so don’t hold\nback in your next battle either, OK?[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: sub_012_chara_07_01
text: I am pleased to be facing you in battle. Now,\nallow me to show you my skills.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: sub_012_chara_07_02
text: What can I say in the face of such strength?\nI should have expected no less from a Champion.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]It’s an honor to battle you,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)].

I’ll

all

for
this one![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_012_chara_08_02
text: Yep! Nicely done! Keep up the winning streak\nfor me, won’t you?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

text:

text: That battle was the best! Thanks—I mean it.\nAnd hey, you went and won it all! Felicidades![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
